verdict.rationale: Railway's own materials state that you build on a visual canvas that shows your entire stack at a glance [railway-docs-2]. They also say you can modify settings directly from that canvas with YAML optional [railway-docs-3], and that auto-config removes setup work [railway-docs-1], which covers visualizing and editing without config files. missing for 10: in-depth documentation of what is editable on the canvas (e.g. networking, scaling, variables), independent or hands-on corroboration of canvas-based editing, and evidence that every infrastructure element can be managed there rather than in config files.
